in_text_mentions: dosis. Further analysis of the perivascular lymphoid populations was undertaken. Histologically, the monotonous populations of perivascular lymphoid cells demonstrated a lymphoplasmacytic appearance (Figure 3(a)). Immunohistochemical analysis demonstrated that the lymphoid cells were CD20 positive (Figure 3(b)). Tumor cells were negative for CD3, CD5, BCL1, and CD23. The tumor Ki67 proliferation index was low (3%). The more plasmacytoid appearing cells were CD138 positive and were shown to be lambda light chain restricted by kappa and lambda chromogenic in situ analysis (Figures 3(c) and 3(d))

Note the Dutcher body (arrow).
